about_the_game:
Welcome to Rainbow Chickens

A charming pixel art chicken management game where your goal is to build the ultimate colorful chicken farm!

Start Small, Dream Big

  • Begin with a single white chicken

  • Carefully manage your farm by feeding, breeding, and nurturing your flock

  • Drag and drop chickens between grass areas, nests, and incubators as you master the art of chicken farming

Strategic Feeding System

  • Corn: basic nutrition

  • Grapes: increase hatching success rates

  • Apples: prevent egg breakage

  • Wheat: nourish chicks to help them grow strong

Master the Egg Cycle

  • Timing is everything

  • Move chickens to nests when it’s time to lay eggs

  • Check eggs for viability

  • Decide whether to sell for profit or incubate for new chicks

  • One broken egg on grass could mean lost opportunities

Collect the Rainbow

  • Unlock uniquely colored chickens by completing achievements, from feeding milestones to breeding successes

  • Each new color brings you closer to the legendary Rainbow Chicken – the ultimate prize for master farmers

Customize Your Flock

  • Visit the accessory shop to dress up your chickens with hats, bows, and other accessories

  • Make your farm as stylish as it is productive

Features

  • Relaxing drag-and-drop gameplay

  • Colorful chicken varieties to collect

  • Achievement-based progression system

  • Charming pixel art graphics

  • Strategic resource management

  • Egg economy system – buy, sell, and trade

  • Cosmetic customization options

  • Ultimate goal: raise the legendary Rainbow Chicken and earn your golden trophy

Perfect for fans of cozy management games, pixel art aesthetics, and adorable farm animals.
Complete your collection and achieve chicken farming greatness!
